select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0'
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.role_key in #{roleKey} )
order by u.user_id

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName from sys_user u where u.nick_name = #{nickName} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0'
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.role_key in #{roleKey} )
order by u.user_id limit 1
